source.note: Categories and clues are roadmap text; non_categories, confidence_levels and all field-level clue mappings are A-006 additions.

categories.label: Source compile
categories.roadmap_clues: C/C++ errors, unsupported intrinsics or headers
categories.roadmap_investigation: Reproduce the single target; identify platform macros and compiler/NDK version.

categories.label: Link
categories.roadmap_clues: Undefined symbols, duplicate definitions, incompatible ELF or missing library
categories.roadmap_investigation: Inspect the link line, ABI, linkage and symbol table.
missing_fields: symbol table (not captured; target_ldd is ldd output only)

categories.label: Loader/startup
categories.roadmap_clues: Missing interpreter or shared library, startup crash
categories.roadmap_investigation: Inspect ELF interpreter, dynamic dependencies and libc environment.
missing_fields: ELF interpreter field (not in A-005 manifest)
confirmed requires not-found/missing-library log or target_ldd evidence; startup crash alone caps probable

categories.label: Address-space configuration
categories.roadmap_investigation: Verify actual virtual-address layout and source configuration; do not infer only from CPU name.

categories.label: System call or sandbox
categories.roadmap_investigation: Capture errno and environment; compare native Linux, Android and proot.
missing_fields: single packet cap is possible; probable requires >=2 packets same case_id different env_class
negative evidence is env_class: identical failure in a second native packet

categories.label: Resource pressure
categories.roadmap_clues: ENOMEM, OOM kill, huge virtual reservation
categories.roadmap_investigation: Record RSS/PSS, address-space limits, memory pressure and kernel logs where accessible.
missing_fields: loadavg_before is supporting colour only, never positive evidence alone
confirmed requires ENOMEM/OOM log text plus corroborating meminfo/RSS field; signal 9 or timeout alone cap possible

categories.label: Allocator correctness
categories.roadmap_investigation: Minimize; use sanitizers or trace tools on an appropriate host and inspect ownership.
missing_fields: stack trace (not captured unless child printed it)
reproducibility cannot be established by one packet
single packet cap is probable; confirmed requires >=2 packets same case_id agreeing on stable fields plus sanitizer/minimised evidence

non_categories.label: Not a failure
non_categories.definition: packet verifies and outcome==pass (exit_code 0, timed_out false, signal null); no failure to classify.

non_categories.label: Expected synthetic failure
non_categories.definition: packet verifies, case synthetic as evidenced inside the packet, matches_expected==true; evidence about capture path only; mimicked category never assigned.

non_categories.label: Insufficient evidence
non_categories.definition: verifies, failure occurred, no category reaches primary threshold or required fields missing.

non_categories.label: Multiple candidates
non_categories.definition: >=2 categories meet primary threshold, no discriminating field separates them, none chosen.

non_categories.label: Harness or capture error
non_categories.definition: packet cannot be trusted (hash/verify failure, incomplete packet, or no valid child result); no category may be assigned; host-mismatch verifier sub-checks alone are not capture errors.

non_categories.label: Out of scope environment
non_categories.definition: packet verifies but env_class does not match scope_question environment; classification stops at scope gate.

confidence_levels.definition: verified packet, >=2 independent positives incl. directly diagnostic log text + structured field, no unexplained negative, no required field missing, cap permits.
exactly 1 diagnostic positive + >=1 corroborating field, no contradictory negative; or confirmed pattern with one required field missing or cap probable.
diagnostic positive but corroboration missing or negative unresolved, or cap possible; non-diagnostic clues alone can never make a category primary.
used only when primary is insufficient-evidence or multiple-candidate; a statement about the packet, not a weak category claim.

outcome_gate.result: not-a-failure - stop; no failure to classify
expected-synthetic - stop; mimicked category never assigned

outcome_gate.condition: capture invalid (hash/verify failure, incomplete packet, or no valid child result)
outcome_gate.result: harness-or-capture-error - stop; no category may be assigned
proceed to clue matching; timed_out is a resource-pressure corroborating clue only
proceed to clue matching; signal 9 is a resource-pressure corroborating clue only
proceed to clue matching; signal is a clue only, category is determined from stage and log evidence

outcome_gate.condition: matches_expected == false on a real failure
outcome_gate.result: proceed on actual outcome; classify the observed failure
